title: ONSure Judge / Reviewer Independence Check v1
description: FR-META-058 AI Nondeterminism and Multi-Agent Assurance / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS12 Judge/Reviewer Independence: 'AI Judge/Reviewer는 target model과 다음 축을 비교한다: provider/model family, prompt/rubric implementation, training/knowledge overlap 가능성, oracle source, hidden benchmark exposure, memory/previous verdict access. 동일 계열 Judge 결과는 보조 corroboration으로 사용할 수 있으나 고신뢰 independent lane을 대체하지 않는다.' Three axes are identity comparisons (judge vs target provider/model family, prompt/rubric implementation, oracle source); three are directly-assessed risk flags (training/knowledge overlap possibility, hidden benchmark exposure, memory/previous verdict access) since they describe a contamination possibility rather than a same-value identity match. lane_eligibility can only be HIGH_CONFIDENCE_INDEPENDENT_LANE when all three identity axes differ AND all three risk flags are false -- any shared identity axis or any true risk flag caps the result at CORROBORATION_ONLY, matching the named prohibition on letting a same-family Judge substitute for a real independent lane.
